awards: Varsity: top 2 teams receive trophies; top 20 individuals receive medals.
Awards are available about 20 minutes after each race at the awards tent (next to the T-shirt tent, outside the stadium by the finish-line exit gate).
notes: Spikes must be 1/4 inch or less.
The race ends on the track.
Parking is $10 per car, CASH ONLY, on the Northmont HS campus. Buses drop off by the Varsity Softball field near the start line.
Team camps: outside the stadium near the start line, or inside the stadium (blacktop area of the visitor stands / under the home stands). No camps in the softball fields.
T-shirts are $15, outside the stadium near team camps. Concessions are available.
